description: Register lugh on the fabric as the specialized, local-only KFT provider `lugh:agent:finetune`, replacing the ecosystem's placeholder `pinakes:agent:finetune`. This is what cuneiform routes to and agora's registry selects. See pinakes docs/LUGH-EXTRACTION-PLAN.md.

userStories.title: KCB manifest advertising lugh:agent:finetune
userStories.description: Emit a KCB capability manifest that advertises lugh as the specialized finetune provider (text-generation x {sft,lora,qlora}, local-only), mirroring agora trainer/manifest.py, validated against the vendored koine finetune-job schema.
acceptanceCriteria: A KCB manifest advertises capability `finetune` for entity `lugh:agent:finetune`, local-only, with the supported modality x method matrix.
The manifest validates against the vendored koine KFT schema; a conformance test asserts it.
The manifest is discoverable the way agora's registry expects (same shape as agora trainer).

userStories.title: Re-namespace the minted identity pinakes -> lugh
userStories.description: Update kft.py/kft_run.py so minted model ids, asset ids, and provider identity use the lugh namespace, not pinakes.
acceptanceCriteria: mint_model_id and asset minting produce `lugh:model:...` / `lugh:asset:...`; provider id is `lugh:agent:finetune`.
The KFT admission/egress/telemetry contract (kft.py/kft_run.py) still passes its tests under the new namespace.
No remaining `pinakes:agent:finetune` string in lugh except historical comments.
